name: tmux
summary: Terminal multiplexer with unconfined access to host pseudo-terminals and processes
description: tmux is a terminal multiplexer that lets you switch easily between several programs in one terminal, detach them and reattach them to a different terminal. Inside Clipak, it accesses the host session sockets and user processes directly.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined host PID access, host pseudo-terminals (/dev/pts), and persistent user session UNIX domain sockets across /run/user
